component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.capture
component.documentation:
The capture service: the providers a server may classify and extract with, each registered here by an id and a class implementing org.nuxeo.agentic.capture.CaptureProvider, and the one the server uses, which its nuxeo.conf names in nuxeo.agentic.capture.provider. With none named, or the one named not configured, nothing is classified: every item waits for a person, and nothing is filed by itself.
The profiles a kit contributes: an inbox's type and its items' type, the record type they are filed on, the classes with their fields, which fields match a record, and the threshold under which nothing is filed without a person.

extension-point.name: providers
extension-point.documentation: A capture provider, by its id, 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and "-", starting with a letter, and its class. enabled="false" removes one.

extension-point.name: profiles
extension-point.documentation:
A capture profile: which inbox and item types it captures, the record type it files on and, if given, the folder records are matched under, the threshold, from 0.5 to 1, 0.85 when none is given, and its classes, each with the fields extracted from it. A field with match names the record's property its value must equal; with format, a pattern its whole value must match. A profile that breaks a rule is not registered, and the server's log says which.
